steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Somatotypes: A system of classifying body types based on physical characteristics. There are three main somatotypes: endomorph, mesomorph and ectomorph. Most people are a blend of all three, with one type being dominant. | Endomorph: A somatotype characterised by a high proportion of body fat, a wide waist and hips, and a rounded, soft body shape. Endomorphs tend to store fat easily and find it difficult to lose weight. | Mesomorph: A somatotype characterised by a muscular, athletic build with broad shoulders, narrow waist and low body fat. Mesomorphs gain muscle easily and have a naturally strong, powerful physique. | Ectomorph: A somatotype characterised by a lean, thin build with low body fat and low muscle mass.
